reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: They keep charging my card, I’ve tried to cancel multiple times, why is apple allowing their customers to be scammed.

reviews.title: App is useless
reviews.text: The web is also useless, you can’t even create a login before creating your resume. Once you finally create your resume and it asks you to create a login, you can’t even do that because it does not give you an option to go back into eh dashboard. They make it really complicated than it should be. Wasting my time.

reviews.title: Ridiculous
reviews.text: Had to pay for a week subscription just to save to files…

reviews.title: Not many options.
reviews.text: Not many options even with paying. Texts are showing up with bullet points in the wrong location and no way to fix it.

reviews.title: Don’t use this app
reviews.text: The app itself is easy to use but once you get all the way to the end, after all that time spent on building your resume, they’ll ask for your card info. Even though I didn’t subscribe I still got charged for an active subscription for months. $28 a month is hilarious for this app. Luckily, I was refunded for the past two months. I’m not sure how many months I was actually charged. Customer service doesn’t have a phone number so you have to reach out via e-mail. Too many red flags. Use any other service for building your resume.
